summary: chore(shared): remove packages/fxa-shared and its tooling references
description:
Because:

- Every module in fxa-shared now lives in libs/ or in the package that uses it.
- Some libs imported moment, jsdom-global and sinon that only fxa-shared declared.

This commit:

- Moves the last two imports to @fxa/shared/sentry-utils and @fxa/accounts/errors.
- Deletes packages/fxa-shared and every workspace dependency on it.
- Removes fxa-shared from CI, scripts, codecov, lint-staged, jest and docs.
- Declares moment, @types/ip, jsdom-global and sinon in the root package.json.
- Aliases @fxa/shared/sentry-utils in the content-server webpack config.

Fixes FXA-14718
